Rule.name: Team Request Status Library
Rule.Description: Helper functions for the My Team's Requests workflow: direct reports, their recent requests, plain-English status, and the results form.

Variable.name: transient
Variable.Description: Keeps the case in memory only; a status lookup leaves nothing behind.

Variable.name: viewAsManager
Variable.Description: Admins only (see TRS_VIEW_AS_CAPABILITIES in the library): the manager whose team to show. Ignored for everyone else.

AfterScript.Source: import sailpoint.object.WorkItem; workflow.put("showAgain", (item != null && item.getState() == WorkItem.State.Finished) ? "true" : "false");

QuickLink.name: My Team's Requests
QuickLink.Description: See where your direct reports' access requests are: waiting on approval, being set up, done, or needing the helpdesk.
